content_sections.heading: ChPA Superintending Engineer (Mech.) (Class I) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.chennai_port_authority_chpa_tamil_nadu: M & EE Department, Chennai Port Authority, Chennai

Officers of Major Port Authorities holding analogous posts, or the feeder post of Executive Engineer with 4 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust, with the qualifications and experience in the Recruitment Rules (Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Communication Engineering and nine years experience, as prescribed for direct recruitment).

content_sections.heading: ChPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. RC1/169/2026/GA gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ChPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Essential (for direct recruitment, as per RR): Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognized university / institution; Nine years experience in relevant discipline in an executive cadre in an Industrial / Commercial / Govt. Undertaking; Absorption / deputation: Officers holding analogous posts or the feeder post with 4 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust Experience: Nine years experience in relevant discipline in an executive cadre in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking (as prescribed in the RR for direct recruitment) Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on 18 December 2026) Other conditions: Open only to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities Applications must be forwarded through proper channel by the officer's Port Authority Crucial date for determining eligibility is 18.12.2026, the last date of receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ChPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date are not considered Applications without ACRs / APARs or without enclosures are not considered Applications not received through proper channel are not considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on absorption / deputation basis Governed by the terms and conditions prescribed by the Central Government Recruitment Rules list a probation period of 2 years for the post

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications (through proper channel)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copies of educational qualifications and experience Undertaking not to withdraw, if selected (Annexure-5) Self attested passport size photo affixed on the application Photocopy of ACRs / APARs for the last 5 years attested by an officer not below Deputy Head of Department No Objection Certificate and Vigilance / Administrative Clearance (Annexure-2) Complete service details in the format at Annexure-4

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ChPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in). Send a print-out of the online application through proper channel with copies of educational qualifications and experience. Attach the undertaking not to withdraw if selected (Annexure-5) and affix a self attested passport size photo on the application. The Port Authority forwards the application with ACRs/APARs, NOC, vigilance clearance and service details to reach Secretary, Chennai Port Authority by 18.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Willingness of the candidate to join the post in case of selection must be forwarded Details of any major or minor penalty in the last 10 years must be sent with documents Circular and Annexures are also available on www.chennaiport.gov.in

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ChPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 December 2026.

faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Superintending Engineer (Mech.) (Class I).

faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities. Applications must be forwarded through proper channel by the officer's Port Authority. Crucial date for determining eligibility is 18.12.2026, the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.answer: Applications received after the last date are not considered. Applications without ACRs / APARs or without enclosures are not considered. Applications not received through proper channel are not considered.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on absorption / deputation basis. Governed by the terms and conditions prescribed by the Central Government. Recruitment Rules list a probation period of 2 years for the post.
